title: Saint Paul Vacant Buildings Register
description: Every building on the City of Saint Paul's vacant building register: address, parcel ID, vacant-since date, dwelling type, category, ward, district and coordinates.
why: A registered vacant building is the most direct distress signal a city publishes. The category says how serious: 1 is secured and maintained, 3 is the worst.
useCases: Investors and wholesalers finding vacant property

category.title: Category
category.description: Vacant building category (1 least to 3 most serious). Empty for all.

vacantSince.title: Vacant on or after (YYYY-MM-DD)
vacantSince.description: Only buildings registered vacant on or after this date.
